text.tspan: RDS disaster recovery: pick the option that meets RPO (data loss) and RTO (downtime)
AWS Backup: policies, vault lock, copies
Cross-region read replica (async, seconds of lag)
promote it to standalone primary in a disaster
Multi-AZ → 0 / 1-2 min / 2x instance; protects against AZ or instance failure ONLY (same region, not against bad deletes)
PITR in same region → ~5 min / tens of minutes to hours (new instance) / low; protects against bad data, deletes
Cross-region snapshot copy → hours / hours / lowest; region loss on a budget
Cross-region read replica → seconds / minutes (promote + repoint app) / 2x; region loss
Aurora Global Database → ~1 s / ~1 min / highest; critical apps
Always: app connects via a DNS name (Route 53 CNAME) so failover = repoint · test the DR drill · encrypt + copy KMS keys
